How often should my valuable imported rugs be professionally cleaned in Tustin? Given the fine dust and regular use in family-centric homes within this affluent suburban community, we recommend professional area rug cleaning every 12 to 18 months. This prevents deeply embedded soil from cutting the fibers and extends the life of your valuable imported rugs (Persian, Oriental). Is in-home carpet cleaning safe for my area rugs placed on luxury hardwood and tile flooring? While we offer excellent carpet cleaning services, we strongly advise against cleaning delicate area rug cleaning (especially imported ones) in the home. Our certified off-site process allows for complete dry soil removal, full saturation, and controlled drying, which is impossible to achieve safely on luxury hardwood and tile flooring and prevents damage to both. We utilize a specialized, dedicated pet odor removal process where the rug is treated and soaked to neutralize the odor-causing bacteria entirely, which is essential before the standard wash process begins, ensuring a complete and fresh restoration.
